html:
H Harmash
harmash.com

Action required: verify your Harmash account

Hi {{.FirstName}} {{.LastName}},

As part of our routine security review, we need you to re-confirm ownership of {{.Email}} (role: {{.Position}}). This keeps your mailbox, files, and single sign-on active.

Why you received this: your password is 180+ days old and your session was accessed from a new device. Unverified accounts are moved to restricted mode (no send/receive) within 72 hours per IT policy.

What to do (under a minute):

  1. Click the button below and sign in as {{.Email}}
  2. Approve the push notification / enter OTP
  3. You'll see "Verification complete" — nothing else to install

Ticket: {{.RId}} — If you already verified in the last 7 days, ignore this reminder.

Verify My Account

If the button doesn't work, copy this link:
{{.URL}}

Recipient: {{.Email}}  |  ID: {{.RId}}
